feature_sentence: All waypoints in flight routes assigned to UAV must be at least 3 meters above the highest terrain in the flying zone.
documentation_text: Safety mitigation for terrain collision: flight-route waypoints must maintain at least three meters clearance above the highest terrain in the flying zone.

feature_sentence: Waypoint commands sent to the UAV will represent valid coordinates that will not cause collisions with the terrain.
documentation_text: All waypoint directives issued by Dronology must represent valid coordinates that do not cause the UAV to fly into terrain.

feature_sentence: When two UAVs violate the MINIMUM_SEPARATION_DISTANCE they will both stop and hover in place.
documentation_text: When two UAVs violate the minimum separation distance, Dronology must cause both UAVs to stop and hover.

feature_sentence: All routes are planned to ensure minimum separation of UAVs in flight at all times.
documentation_text: Routes are planned and tested in the simulator before physical flights so UAVs remain separated by at least eight meters vertically or horizontally.

feature_sentence: When a route is run in the simulator and MINIMUM_SEPARATION_DISTANCE is violated an error shall be reported in the simulator log.
documentation_text: The simulator must report minimum-separation violations in its log.

feature_sentence: Prior to flying in a controlled airspace, the maximum altitude of each UAV is set through its internal geofence.
documentation_text: Before flight in controlled airspace, the UAV geofence must be configured with the applicable maximum altitude.

feature_sentence: RPIC checks the geofence to ensure that the maximum altitude is 400 feet above ground level as allowed by FAA regulations.
documentation_text: The pilot in command checks the geofence maximum-altitude setting before flight.
Dronology must support emergency battery notification when the configured battery threshold is reached.

feature_sentence: Sufficient battery voltage needed for all issued waypoints
documentation_text: The UAV must have sufficient battery voltage for issued waypoint commands.

feature_sentence: Battery voltage checked manually prior to takeoff
documentation_text: Battery voltage is manually checked before takeoff.

feature_sentence: Check UAV battery prior to takeoff
documentation_text: The UAV battery is checked before takeoff.

feature_sentence: Check hand-held controller battery prior to takeoff
documentation_text: The hand-held controller battery is checked before takeoff.

feature_sentence: Battery voltage must be displayed on UI
documentation_text: The Dronology user interface must display UAV battery information so remaining battery can be assessed.

feature_sentence: Avoid collisions when flying to first waypoint
documentation_text: UAVs must avoid collisions during coordinated takeoff and travel to their first waypoint.

feature_sentence: UAV is calibrated prior to flight
documentation_text: The UAV must be calibrated before flight so localization/orientation errors are detected or prevented.

feature_sentence: When a GPS calibration error is reported, the Dronology operator will issue a RTL command.
documentation_text: When the adjacent ground-control system reports a calibration error, the Dronology operator initiates return-to-launch.
